stem: 基于风险的反金融犯罪（AFC）方法涉及通过以下方式了解和管理风险：

options.A: 对所有客户实施统一的控制措施，而不考虑其风险状况
options.B: 根据已识别风险的程度分配资源并实施控制措施
options.C: 将监管合规置于客户体验和运营效率之上
options.D: 依靠自动化系统来检测和缓解AFC风险

stem_en: A risk-based approach (RBA) to anti-financial crime (AFC) involves understanding and managing risks by:

options_en.A: Applying uniform controls to all customers, regardless of their risk profile
options_en.B: Allocating resources and implementing controls based on the level of identified risks
options_en.C: Prioritizing regulatory compliance over customer experience and operational efficiency
options_en.D: Relying on automated systems to detect and mitigate AFC risks
